num_wann.name: num_wann
num_wann.description: Number of Wannier functions to compute.

num_bands.name: num_bands
num_bands.description: Total number of bands passed to Wannier90. If num_bands > num_wann, a disentanglement procedure is activated.

unit_cell_cart.name: unit_cell_cart
unit_cell_cart.description: Lattice vectors of the unit cell in Cartesian coordinates. Optional first line specifies units (Bohr or Ang). Three lines of three real numbers each (a1, a2, a3).

atoms_cart.name: atoms_cart
atoms_cart.description: Atomic positions in Cartesian coordinates. Optional first line specifies units (Bohr or Ang). Each subsequent line: species x y z.

atoms_frac.name: atoms_frac
atoms_frac.description: Atomic positions in fractional (crystallographic) coordinates. Each line: species f1 f2 f3.

mp_grid.name: mp_grid
mp_grid.description: Dimensions of the Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid. Three integers: n1 n2 n3.

kpoints.name: kpoints
kpoints.description: Explicit list of k-points in fractional coordinates of the reciprocal lattice vectors. One k-point per line: k1 k2 k3. Total number must equal product of mp_grid.

gamma_only.name: gamma_only
gamma_only.description: If true, use a Gamma-point-only branch of the code. Only mp_grid = 1 1 1 is permitted.

spinors.name: spinors
spinors.description: If true, WFs are spinor (two-component) functions. Requires num_bands and num_wann to be even.

shell_list.name: shell_list
shell_list.description: List of shells to use in determining k-point nearest neighbours. If not set, determined automatically.

search_shells.name: search_shells
search_shells.description: Number of shells to search when automatically determining nearest-neighbour k-points.

skip_b1_tests.name: skip_b1_tests
skip_b1_tests.description: If true, skip the B1 completeness tests on the k-point nearest-neighbour shells.

nnkpts.name: nnkpts
nnkpts.description: Explicit specification of nearest-neighbour k-point pairs. First line: number of neighbours per k-point. Subsequent lines: k-point index, neighbour index, G-vector (g1, g2, g3).

kmesh_tol.name: kmesh_tol
kmesh_tol.description: Tolerance for identifying k-point shells as satisfying the B1 condition.

projections.name: projections
projections.description: Defines initial projections for Wannier functions. Format per line: site:ang_mtm[:zaxis=z1,z2,z3][:xaxis=x1,x2,x3][:radial=R][:zona=Z]. site can be a fractional position f=f1,f2,f3 or a Cartesian position c=c1,c2,c3 or an atomic species name. ang_mtm is the angular momentum state (s, p, d, f, sp, sp2, sp3, sp3d, sp3d2, or specific orbitals like px, dxy, etc.). Multiple projections can be separated by newlines within the block. The keyword 'random' may be used for random projections.

postproc_setup.name: postproc_setup
postproc_setup.description: If true, Wannier90 outputs the .nnkp file and exits. Used for interface setup before running the first-principles code.

exclude_bands.name: exclude_bands
exclude_bands.description: List of bands to exclude from the calculation. Bands are indexed by their order in the original first-principles calculation.

select_projections.name: select_projections
select_projections.description: List of projection indices to use from those defined in the projections block. Allows selection of a subset of projections.

auto_projections.name: auto_projections
auto_projections.description: If true, use the SCDM method to automatically generate initial projections rather than requiring a projections block.

restart.name: restart
restart.description: Controls restarting from a previous calculation. Determines which stage to restart from.

iprint.name: iprint
iprint.description: Verbosity level for output. Higher values produce more detailed output.

length_unit.name: length_unit
length_unit.description: Unit of length for output. Determines whether output distances are in Angstroms or Bohr.

wvfn_formatted.name: wvfn_formatted
wvfn_formatted.description: If true, read wavefunction files (UNK) as formatted (ASCII) files rather than unformatted (binary).

spin.name: spin
spin.description: Spin channel to use in a spin-polarised calculation.

devel_flag.name: devel_flag
devel_flag.description: Developer flag for activating experimental/debug features. Not intended for production use.

timing_level.name: timing_level
timing_level.description: Controls the level of timing information reported in the output.

optimisation.name: optimisation
optimisation.description: Level of code optimisation. Higher values enable more aggressive memory/speed trade-offs.

translate_home_cell.name: translate_home_cell
translate_home_cell.description: If true, translate the final Wannier function centres to the home unit cell.

write_xyz.name: write_xyz
write_xyz.description: If true, write atomic positions and Wannier function centres to an XYZ file.

write_vdw_data.name: write_vdw_data
write_vdw_data.description: If true, write data needed for van der Waals energy functional calculations.

write_hr_diag.name: write_hr_diag
write_hr_diag.description: If true, write the diagonal elements of the Hamiltonian in the WF basis to the output.

dis_win_min.name: dis_win_min
dis_win_min.description: Lower bound of the outer (disentanglement) energy window.

dis_win_max.name: dis_win_max
dis_win_max.description: Upper bound of the outer (disentanglement) energy window.

dis_froz_min.name: dis_froz_min
dis_froz_min.description: Lower bound of the inner (frozen) energy window. States within the frozen window are preserved exactly.

dis_froz_max.name: dis_froz_max
dis_froz_max.description: Upper bound of the inner (frozen) energy window. Must be set to activate the frozen window.

dis_num_iter.name: dis_num_iter
dis_num_iter.description: Maximum number of iterations in the disentanglement procedure.

dis_mix_ratio.name: dis_mix_ratio
dis_mix_ratio.description: Mixing ratio for the disentanglement iterations. Controls how much of the new subspace is mixed with the previous iteration.

dis_conv_tol.name: dis_conv_tol
dis_conv_tol.description: Convergence tolerance for the disentanglement Omega_I spread functional.

dis_conv_window.name: dis_conv_window
dis_conv_window.description: Number of consecutive iterations over which the convergence criterion (dis_conv_tol) must be satisfied.

dis_spheres_num.name: dis_spheres_num
dis_spheres_num.description: Number of k-space spheres for constraining the disentanglement.

dis_spheres_first_wann.name: dis_spheres_first_wann
dis_spheres_first_wann.description: Index of the first Wannier function associated with the disentanglement spheres constraint.

dis_spheres.name: dis_spheres
dis_spheres.description: Defines spheres in k-space for constraining disentanglement. Each line: k1 k2 k3 radius (in reciprocal lattice units and inverse Angstroms).

num_iter.name: num_iter
num_iter.description: Maximum number of iterations for the Wannier function spread minimisation.

num_cg_steps.name: num_cg_steps
num_cg_steps.description: Number of conjugate-gradient steps within each iteration of the spread minimisation.

conv_window.name: conv_window
conv_window.description: Number of consecutive iterations over which convergence is assessed. A value of -1 disables convergence-based termination.

conv_tol.name: conv_tol
conv_tol.description: Convergence tolerance for the total spread Omega. Minimisation stops when the change in Omega is less than this over conv_window iterations.

precond.name: precond
precond.description: If true, use a preconditioner in the minimisation of the spread functional.

conv_noise_amp.name: conv_noise_amp
conv_noise_amp.description: Amplitude of random noise added to the gradient when convergence stalls. A negative value disables noise injection.

conv_noise_num.name: conv_noise_num
conv_noise_num.description: Number of iterations over which random noise is applied when convergence stalls.

num_dump_cycles.name: num_dump_cycles
num_dump_cycles.description: Frequency (in iterations) at which checkpoint files are written during the minimisation.

num_print_cycles.name: num_print_cycles
num_print_cycles.description: Frequency (in iterations) at which spread functional values are printed to output.

write_r2mn.name: write_r2mn
write_r2mn.description: If true, write the matrix elements <m|r^2|n> to the seedname.r2mn file.

guiding_centres.name: guiding_centres
guiding_centres.description: If true, use guiding centres to improve the minimisation of the spread functional. Adds a penalty term that penalises centres drifting far from initial projections.

num_guide_cycles.name: num_guide_cycles
num_guide_cycles.description: Number of iterations in each guiding-centre cycle before the guiding penalty is updated.

num_no_guide_iter.name: num_no_guide_iter
num_no_guide_iter.description: Number of initial iterations to perform without the guiding centres penalty.

trial_step.name: trial_step
trial_step.description: Size of the trial step in the line search during minimisation.

fixed_step.name: fixed_step
fixed_step.description: If set, use a fixed step size instead of a line search in the minimisation.

use_bloch_phases.name: use_bloch_phases
use_bloch_phases.description: If true, use the Bloch phases of the wavefunctions as the starting gauge rather than projections.

site_symmetry.name: site_symmetry
site_symmetry.description: If true, construct symmetry-adapted Wannier functions using site symmetry.

symmetrize_eps.name: symmetrize_eps
symmetrize_eps.description: Tolerance for symmetrisation of the Wannier function centres when site_symmetry is true.

slwf_num.name: slwf_num
slwf_num.description: Number of objective Wannier functions in selectively-localised Wannier function (SLWF) calculations.

slwf_constrain.name: slwf_constrain
slwf_constrain.description: If true, constrain the centres of the selectively-localised Wannier functions to specified positions.

slwf_lambda.name: slwf_lambda
slwf_lambda.description: Lagrange multiplier (constraint strength) for the SLWF centre constraint.

slwf_centres.name: slwf_centres
slwf_centres.description: Target centres for constrained SLWF. Each line: f1 f2 f3 (fractional coordinates). Number of lines must equal slwf_num.

wannier_plot.name: wannier_plot
wannier_plot.description: If true, plot the Wannier functions in real space.

wannier_plot_list.name: wannier_plot_list
wannier_plot_list.description: List of Wannier function indices to plot. If not set, all Wannier functions are plotted.

wannier_plot_supercell.name: wannier_plot_supercell
wannier_plot_supercell.description: Size of the supercell for plotting. A single integer applies to all directions; three integers specify each direction independently.

wannier_plot_format.name: wannier_plot_format
wannier_plot_format.description: Output file format for Wannier function plots.

wannier_plot_mode.name: wannier_plot_mode
wannier_plot_mode.description: Plotting mode for Wannier functions. 'crystal' uses periodic boundary conditions; 'molecule' does not.

wannier_plot_radius.name: wannier_plot_radius
wannier_plot_radius.description: Cutoff radius for plotting Wannier functions in molecule mode.

wannier_plot_scale.name: wannier_plot_scale
wannier_plot_scale.description: Scaling factor applied to the Wannier function isosurface in the plot.

wannier_plot_spinor_mode.name: wannier_plot_spinor_mode
wannier_plot_spinor_mode.description: Controls which spinor component to plot for spinor Wannier functions.

wannier_plot_spinor_phase.name: wannier_plot_spinor_phase
wannier_plot_spinor_phase.description: If true, plot the phase of the spinor Wannier functions.

bands_plot.name: bands_plot
bands_plot.description: If true, compute and plot the band structure along a specified k-point path using Wannier interpolation.

kpoint_path.name: kpoint_path
kpoint_path.description: Defines the k-point path for band structure interpolation. Each line specifies a segment: label_start k1_s k2_s k3_s  label_end k1_e k2_e k3_e. Labels are used for the x-axis of the band plot. k-points are in fractional reciprocal-lattice coordinates.

bands_num_points.name: bands_num_points
bands_num_points.description: Number of k-points along each segment of the band structure path.

bands_plot_format.name: bands_plot_format
bands_plot_format.description: Output format for band structure plot data files.

bands_plot_project.name: bands_plot_project
bands_plot_project.description: List of Wannier function indices onto which to project the band structure (fat bands).

bands_plot_mode.name: bands_plot_mode
bands_plot_mode.description: Mode for band structure plotting. 's-k' for standard path plotting; 'cut' for k-space cuts.

bands_plot_dim.name: bands_plot_dim
bands_plot_dim.description: Dimensionality of the system for band structure plotting.

fermi_surface_plot.name: fermi_surface_plot
fermi_surface_plot.description: If true, compute the Fermi surface using Wannier interpolation.

fermi_surface_num_points.name: fermi_surface_num_points
fermi_surface_num_points.description: Number of divisions along each reciprocal lattice vector for Fermi surface sampling.

fermi_energy.name: fermi_energy
fermi_energy.description: Fermi energy for band structure and Fermi surface plots.

fermi_energy_min.name: fermi_energy_min
fermi_energy_min.description: Minimum Fermi energy when scanning over a range (for DOS and transport calculations).

fermi_energy_max.name: fermi_energy_max
fermi_energy_max.description: Maximum Fermi energy when scanning over a range (for DOS and transport calculations).

fermi_energy_step.name: fermi_energy_step
fermi_energy_step.description: Step size for Fermi energy scans.

fermi_surface_plot_format.name: fermi_surface_plot_format
fermi_surface_plot_format.description: Output format for Fermi surface data.

write_hr.name: write_hr
write_hr.description: If true, write the Hamiltonian in the Wannier function basis to seedname_hr.dat.

write_rmn.name: write_rmn
write_rmn.description: If true, write the position operator matrix elements <m|r|n> in the WF basis to seedname_r.dat.

write_bvec.name: write_bvec
write_bvec.description: If true, write the b-vectors (k-point differences) to seedname.bvec.

write_tb.name: write_tb
write_tb.description: If true, write the tight-binding Hamiltonian in the WF basis for use in external codes.

write_u_matrices.name: write_u_matrices
write_u_matrices.description: If true, write the unitary matrices U(k) and U_dis(k) to files.

hr_cutoff.name: hr_cutoff
hr_cutoff.description: Cutoff threshold for Hamiltonian matrix elements in the WF basis. Elements with magnitude below this are set to zero.

dist_cutoff.name: dist_cutoff
dist_cutoff.description: Distance cutoff for Hamiltonian matrix elements. Hopping terms between WFs separated by more than this distance are set to zero.

dist_cutoff_mode.name: dist_cutoff_mode
dist_cutoff_mode.description: Dimensionality mode for the distance cutoff. Controls whether the distance is measured in 3D, projected onto a 2D plane, or along a 1D axis.

one_dim_axis.name: one_dim_axis
one_dim_axis.description: Axis along which to measure distance when dist_cutoff_mode is one_dim.

translation_centre_frac.name: translation_centre_frac
translation_centre_frac.description: Fractional coordinates of the translation centre for the Wigner-Seitz supercell used in real-space Hamiltonian construction.

use_ws_distance.name: use_ws_distance
use_ws_distance.description: If true, use the Wigner-Seitz cell to determine inter-cell distances for Fourier transforms, improving convergence.

ws_distance_tol.name: ws_distance_tol
ws_distance_tol.description: Tolerance for determining degenerate lattice vectors in the Wigner-Seitz distance calculation.

ws_search_size.name: ws_search_size
ws_search_size.description: Size of the supercell searched to identify Wigner-Seitz lattice vectors. A single integer applies to all directions; three integers specify each independently.

transport.name: transport
transport.description: If true, perform quantum transport calculations using the Wannier function Hamiltonian.

transport_mode.name: transport_mode
transport_mode.description: Mode of transport calculation. 'bulk' for bulk systems; 'lcr' for lead-conductor-lead geometry.

tran_win_min.name: tran_win_min
tran_win_min.description: Lower bound of the energy window for transport calculations.

tran_win_max.name: tran_win_max
tran_win_max.description: Upper bound of the energy window for transport calculations.

tran_energy_step.name: tran_energy_step
tran_energy_step.description: Energy step for the grid in transport calculations.

tran_num_bb.name: tran_num_bb
tran_num_bb.description: Number of Wannier functions in a bulk principal layer.

tran_num_ll.name: tran_num_ll
tran_num_ll.description: Number of Wannier functions in the left lead principal layer.

tran_num_rr.name: tran_num_rr
tran_num_rr.description: Number of Wannier functions in the right lead principal layer.

tran_num_cc.name: tran_num_cc
tran_num_cc.description: Number of Wannier functions in the conductor region.

tran_num_lc.name: tran_num_lc
tran_num_lc.description: Number of Wannier functions in the left lead-conductor coupling region.

tran_num_cr.name: tran_num_cr
tran_num_cr.description: Number of Wannier functions in the conductor-right lead coupling region.

tran_num_cell_ll.name: tran_num_cell_ll
tran_num_cell_ll.description: Number of unit cells in the left lead used for transport calculation.

tran_num_cell_rr.name: tran_num_cell_rr
tran_num_cell_rr.description: Number of unit cells in the right lead used for transport calculation.

tran_num_bandc.name: tran_num_bandc
tran_num_bandc.description: Number of bands in the conductor region for transport.

tran_write_ht.name: tran_write_ht
tran_write_ht.description: If true, write the tight-binding Hamiltonian for the transport calculation to file.

tran_read_ht.name: tran_read_ht
tran_read_ht.description: If true, read the tight-binding Hamiltonian for transport from a file instead of computing it.

tran_use_same_lead.name: tran_use_same_lead
tran_use_same_lead.description: If true, assume the left and right leads are identical, reducing computational cost.

tran_group_threshold.name: tran_group_threshold
tran_group_threshold.description: Threshold distance for grouping Wannier functions in the transport calculation.

kpath.name: kpath
kpath.description: If true, enable k-path related postprocessing in postw90 (e.g., band structure interpolation with spin texture).

kpath_task.name: kpath_task
kpath_task.description: Task to perform along the k-path in postw90.

kpath_bands_colour.name: kpath_bands_colour
kpath_bands_colour.description: Quantity used to colour the band structure plot along the k-path.

kpath_num_points.name: kpath_num_points
kpath_num_points.description: Number of k-points per segment along the k-path for postw90 band interpolation.

kslice.name: kslice
kslice.description: If true, enable k-slice (2D k-space sampling) postprocessing in postw90.

kslice_task.name: kslice_task
kslice_task.description: Task to perform on the k-slice in postw90.

kslice_2dkmesh.name: kslice_2dkmesh
kslice_2dkmesh.description: Dimensions of the 2D k-mesh for the k-slice. Two integers: n1 n2.

kslice_corner.name: kslice_corner
kslice_corner.description: Origin (corner) of the k-slice in fractional reciprocal-lattice coordinates. Three reals: k1 k2 k3.

kslice_b1.name: kslice_b1
kslice_b1.description: First spanning vector of the k-slice in fractional reciprocal-lattice coordinates. Three reals.

kslice_b2.name: kslice_b2
kslice_b2.description: Second spanning vector of the k-slice in fractional reciprocal-lattice coordinates. Three reals.

berry.name: berry
berry.description: If true, enable Berry phase related postprocessing in postw90 (e.g., anomalous Hall conductivity, orbital magnetisation, spin Hall conductivity).

berry_task.name: berry_task
berry_task.description: Task to perform for Berry phase calculations. Options include anomalous Hall conductivity (ahc), orbital magnetisation (morb), Kubo conductivity (kubo), spin Hall conductivity (sc/eval_shc).

berry_kmesh.name: berry_kmesh
berry_kmesh.description: Dimensions of the interpolated k-mesh for Berry phase calculations. One or three integers.

berry_curv_unit.name: berry_curv_unit
berry_curv_unit.description: Unit for the Berry curvature output.

berry_curv_adpt_kmesh.name: berry_curv_adpt_kmesh
berry_curv_adpt_kmesh.description: Size of the adaptive refinement k-mesh around points where the Berry curvature is large.

berry_curv_adpt_kmesh_thresh.name: berry_curv_adpt_kmesh_thresh
berry_curv_adpt_kmesh_thresh.description: Threshold for adaptive refinement of the Berry curvature k-mesh.

shc_freq_scan.name: shc_freq_scan
shc_freq_scan.description: If true, compute the spin Hall conductivity as a function of frequency.

shc_alpha.name: shc_alpha
shc_alpha.description: Cartesian index alpha for the spin Hall conductivity tensor sigma_alpha_beta^gamma.

shc_beta.name: shc_beta
shc_beta.description: Cartesian index beta for the spin Hall conductivity tensor sigma_alpha_beta^gamma.

shc_gamma.name: shc_gamma
shc_gamma.description: Cartesian index gamma (spin direction) for the spin Hall conductivity tensor sigma_alpha_beta^gamma.

kubo_adpt_smr.name: kubo_adpt_smr
kubo_adpt_smr.description: If true, use adaptive smearing in Kubo formula calculations.

kubo_smr_fixed_en_width.name: kubo_smr_fixed_en_width
kubo_smr_fixed_en_width.description: Fixed energy width for smearing in Kubo formula when adaptive smearing is disabled.
